            vis.EndScene()
        # Get driver inputs and synchronize the vehicle, terrain, and driver systems.

        driver.Synchronize(time)  # Synchronize the driver system.
        terrain.Synchronize(time)  # Synchronize the terrain.

        # Advance the simulation for all modules by one timestep.

import pychrono as chrono
import pychrono.vehicle as veh
import pychrono.vehicle.hmmwv as hmmwv
import pychrono.vehicle.manipulator
import pychrono.vehicle.terrain
import pychrono_ros
import rclpy

def main():
    # Initialize ROS 2 Python client library
    rclpy.init()

    # 1. Initialize PyChrono core components
    # Choose contact method: NSC (non-smooth) or SCM (smooth)
    contact_method = chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC  # or chrono.ChContactMethod_SMC
    
    # Create Chrono system
    system = chrono.ChSystemNSC() if contact_method == chrono.ChContactMethod_NSC else chrono.ChSystemSMC()
    system.SetLcpSolverType(chrono.ChLcpSolverType_APGD)
    system.SetMaxItersSolverSpeed(100)
    system.SetMaxPenetrationRecoverySpeed(8)
    system.SetTolForce(1e-4)
    system.Set_G_acc(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, -9.81))  # Set gravity

    # 2. Add the HMMWV vehicle
    vehicle = hmmwv.HMMWV_Vehicle(contact_method)
    vehicle.SetInitPosition(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0.5), chrono.QUNIT))
    vehicle.SetEngineType(veh.EngineTypeShaft)  # Example: shaft engine
    vehicle.SetChassisCollisionType(veh.ChassisCollisionType_NONE)  # For faster simulation
    # Tire model selection, e.g. TMEASY
    vehicle.SetTireType(veh.TireModelType_TMEASY)

    vehicle.Initialize()

    # Settle vehicle (optional)
    vehicle.GetVehicle().SetUseTrackPoint(true)

    # Initialize terrain
    # 3. Create flat rigid terrain with specified friction and restitution
    terrain = vehicle.GetVehicle().GetTerrain()
    terrain.Init(chrono.ChCoordsysD(chrono.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), chrono.QUNIT))
    terrain.SetContactFriction(0.8)
    terrain.SetContactRestitution(0.1)
    # Flat terrain already, no height map

    # 3. Initialize driver system for vehicle control
    driver = veh.ChIrrGuiDriver(vehicle)

    # Alternatively, setup a driver that can connect to ROS inputs (will override later)
    step_size = 0.001  # Simulation timestep

    driver.SetInputDelay(0.1)
    driver.Initialize()

    # 4. Initialize ROS Manager, register handlers
    # Chrono ROS manager requires ROS2 node and Chrono system, vehicle, driver and optionally driver inputs
    ros_manager = pychrono_ros.ChRosManager(system, "chrono_vehicle_sim")
    ros_manager.RegisterSystem(vehicle)
    ros_manager.RegisterSystem(driver)
    ros_manager.RegisterSystem(terrain)

    # Register ROS handlers:
    # - for clock synchronization
    ros_manager.RegisterClockHandler()
    # - driver inputs handler (e.g., subscribe to cmd_vel or custom driver commands)
    ros_manager.RegisterDriverHandler(driver)
    # - vehicle state publisher handler
    ros_manager.RegisterVehicleStateHandler(vehicle)

    # Initialize ROS Manager
    ros_manager.Initialize()

    # 5. Simulation loop
    realtime_timer = chrono.ChRealtimeStepTimer()
    while rclpy.ok():
        # Spin ROS node once to check any incoming messages (driver inputs, clock)
        ros_manager.ProcessROS()

        # Synchronize all systems at current time
        t = system.GetChTime()
        driver.Synchronize(t)
        vehicle.Synchronize(t, driver.GetInputs(), terrain)
        terrain.Synchronize(t)
        ros_manager.OnStep(t)

        # Advance simulation by step_size
        driver.Advance(step_size)
        vehicle.Advance(step_size)
        terrain.Advance(step_size)
        system.DoStepDynamics(step_size)

        # Update ROS topics with new simulation data
        ros_manager.PostStep(t)

        realtime_timer.Spin(step_size)

    # Shutdown ROS when exiting
    rclpy.shutdown()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

    patch_mat = ch.ChMaterialSurfaceNSC()  # Create a contact material for the terrain (NSC contact method)
    patch_mat.SetFriction(0.9)  # Set friction for the terrain.
    patch_mat.SetRestitution(0.01)  # Set restitution (bounciness) for the terrain.

    patch = terrain.AddPatch(patch_mat, ch.CSYSNORM, 100.0, 100.0)  # Add a patch to the terrain.
    patch.SetTexture(veh.GetDataFile("terrain/textures/tile4.jpg"), 100, 100)  # Set texture for the patch
    terrain.Initialize()  # Initialize the terrain.

    # Create and initialize the driver system.
    driver = veh.ChDriver(hmmwv.GetVehicle())
    driver.Initialize()  # Initialize the driver system.

    # Create the ROS manager and register handlers for communication.
    ros_manager = chros.ChROSPythonManager()
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSClockHandler())  # Register the clock handler to synchronize ROS with the simulation.
    # Register the driver inputs handler for ROS topic '~/input/driver_inputs'.
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSDriverInputsHandler(25, driver, "~/input/driver_inputs"))
    # Register the vehicle state handler to publish vehicle state to ROS topic '~/output/hmmwv/state'.
    ros_manager.RegisterHandler(chros.ChROSBodyHandler(25, hmmwv.GetChassisBody(), "~/output/hmmwv/state"))
    ros_manager.Initialize()  # Initialize the ROS manager.

    # Create the Irrlicht visualization system
    vis = chronoirr.ChVisualSystemIrrlicht()
    vis.AttachSystem(hmmwv.GetSystem())
    vis.SetWindowTitle("HMMWV Vehicle")
    vis.SetWindowSize(1280, 720)
    vis.Initialize()
    vis.AddSkyBox()
    vis.AddCamera(chronoirr.ChCoordsysD(ch.ChVectorD(0, -10, 1.75), chronoirr.Q_from_AngY(ch.CH_C_PI / 6)))
    vis.AddLightWithShadow(chronoirr.ChVectorD(2, 4, 2), chronoirr.ChVectorD(0, 0, 0), 9, 1, 20, 512, 2, 7)
    vis.SetChaseCamera(chronoirr.ChVectorD(0.0, 0.0, 1.75), 6.0, 0.5)
    vis.EnableTimestepPrint(False)

    # Simulation parameters
    time = 0
    time_step = 1e-3  # Define the simulation time step.
    time_end = 30  # Set the total duration of the simulation.

    hmmwv.GetVehicle().EnableRealtime(True)  # Enable real-time simulation for the vehicle.

    while vis.Run() and (time < time_end):
        time = hmmwv.GetSystem().GetChTime()  # Update simulation time.

        # Get driver inputs and synchronize the vehicle, terrain, and driver systems.
        driver_inputs = driver.GetInputs()
        driver.Synchronize(time)
        terrain.Synchronize(time)
        hmmwv.Synchronize(time, driver_inputs, terrain)

        # Advance simulation for all modules by one timestep.
        driver.Advance(time_step)
        terrain.Advance(time_step)
        hmmwv.Advance(time_step)

        # Update the ROS manager to handle data publishing.
        if not ros_manager.Update(time, time_step):
            break  # Exit loop if ROS manager update fails.

        # Render the scene
        vis.BeginScene()
        vis.Render()
        vis.EndScene()

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
